Cosentyx

What is the patient’s age?
Pediatric (12+ Years)
66–198 lbs
Loading Dose
150 mg at Weeks 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4
Maintenance Dose
150 mg every 4 weeks
Dispensed as:
1 × 150 mg/mL SensoReady Pen
1 × 150 mg/mL Prefilled Syringe
≥ 198 lbs
Loading Dose
300 mg at Weeks 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4
Maintenance Dose
300 mg every 4 weeks
Dispensed as:
1 × 300 mg/2 mL UnoReady Pen
2 × 150 mg/mL SensoReady Pen
2 × 150 mg/mL Prefilled Syringe
Adults (18+ Years)
Loading Dose
300 mg at Weeks 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4
Maintenance Dose
300 mg every 4 weeks
If inadequate response:
Consider increasing to 300 mg every 2 weeks
Dispensed as:
1 × 300 mg/2 mL UnoReady Pen
2 × 150 mg/mL SensoReady Pen
2 × 150 mg/mL Prefilled Syringe
UnoReady Pen: 300 mg/2 mL  •  SensoReady Pen: 150 mg/mL  •  Prefilled Syringe: 150 mg/mL or 75 mg/0.5 mL
